items: `response.ok` checks for a successful HTTP status. A completed fetch can still contain a 404 or another error response.

blocks.text: With a real books.json file at that address, the code prints its parsed data. Missing files produce a handled error.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Create the local JSON file first. fetch does not reject automatically for every HTTP error status.
